name: Tsu Yung
bio: Tsu Yung is dated by Giles to the 8th century AD. His poem here describes a woodland grotto and its quiet.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: A Grotto
poems.author: Tsu Yung
poems.text:
Deep in a darksome grove their Grotto lies,
And deep the thoughts that now within me rise.
Fronting the door the South Hill looming near,
The forest mirrored in the river clear,
The bamboo bends beneath last winter's snow,
The court-yard darkens ere the day sinks low.
I seem to pass beyond this world of clay,
And sit and listen to the spring-bird's lay.

poems.title: On Seeing the Snow-Peak of Chung-nan
poems.author: Tsu Yung
poems.translator: trans. Witter Bynner and Kiang Kang-hu (1929)
poems.text:
See how Chung-nan Mountain soars
With its white top over floating clouds —
And a warm sky opening at the snow-line
While the town in the valley grows colder and colder.

poems.title: Looking Toward an Inner Gate of the Great Wall
poems.author: Tsu Yung
poems.translator: trans. Witter Bynner and Kiang Kang-hu (1929)
poems.text:
My heart sank when I headed north from Yen Country
To the camps of China echoing with bugle and drum.
. . . In an endless cold light of massive snow,
Tall flags on three borders rise up like a dawn.
War-torches invade the barbarian moonlight,
Mountain-clouds like chairmen bear the Great Wall from the sea.
. . . Though no youthful clerk meant to be a great general, I throw aside my writing-brush —
Like the student who tossed off cap for a lariat, I challenge what may come.

poems.title: 蘇氏別業 (Su shi bie ye)
poems.author: Tsu Yung
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
別業居幽處，到來生隱心。
南山當戶牖，澧水映園林。
竹覆經冬雪，庭昏未夕陰。
寥寥人境外，閒坐聽春禽。

poems.title: 江南旅情 (Jiang nan lu qing)
poems.author: Tsu Yung
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
楚山不可極，歸路但蕭條。
海色晴看雨，江聲夜聽潮。
劍留南鬥近，書寄北風遙。
爲報空潭橘，無媒寄洛橋。

poems.title: 終南望餘雪 (Zhong nan wang yu xue)
poems.author: Tsu Yung
poems.collection: 唐詩三百首 (Three Hundred Tang Poems)
poems.text:
終南陰嶺秀，積雪浮雲端。
林表明霽色，城中增暮寒。

poems.title: 望薊門 (Wang ji men)
poems.author: Tsu Yung
poems.collection: 唐詩三百首 (Three Hundred Tang Poems)
poems.text:
燕臺一望客心驚，笳鼓喧喧漢將營。
萬里寒光生積雪，三邊曙色動危旌。
沙場烽火侵胡月，海畔雲山擁薊城。
少小雖非投筆吏，論功還欲請長纓。
